newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices dip on governemnt supplies.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices dip on governemnt supplies.

text.p: Sugar prices suffered a setback on Friday, traders said.
"Consumer demand was low and improved supplies pulled down prices," a trader said. "Arrivals improved today as government has released more free sale sugar," one broker said.
"Earlier government had announced free sale quota of 800,000 tonnes for November but thereafter actually released only 780,000 tonnes," he said.
"The remaining 20,000 tonnes of sugar has been released by the government now," he added.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 slid by 10 rupees at 1,240/1,275 rupees per quintal while M-30 fell by 5/12 rupees at 1,260/1,313 rupees per quintal.
Sugar mill delivery slipped 10 rupees to 1,170/1,180 rupees per quintal.
